overview.en:
Find current Cogedim new-build lots and developments by location, budget, rooms, property type, and investment scheme, and retrieve official buying guidance.

Research new-build property options with explicit location, budget, and property criteria. Keep listing details distinct from general purchasing guidance.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
按地区、预算、户型和投资条件查询新房项目与购房指南。

在明确地区、预算与户型条件后研究新房选择，区分具体房源信息与一般购房指南。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find new-build projects matching this location and budget.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找符合这个地区与预算的新房项目。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these developments by the available property criteria.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据可用房产条件比较这些楼盘。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available buying guidance for this property search.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总适用于这次找房的可用购房指南。
